entries.title: Isaiah 21:1
segments: ¶The burden against the Wilderness of the Sea. As whirlwinds in the South pass through, [So] it comes from the desert, from a terrible land.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:2
segments: A distressing vision is declared to me; The treacherous dealer deals treacherously, And the plunderer plunders. Go up, O Elam! Besiege, O Media! All its sighing I have made to cease.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:3
segments: Therefore my loins are filled with pain; Pangs have taken hold of me, like the pangs of a woman in labor. I was distressed when [I] heard [it]; I was dismayed when [I] saw [it].

entries.title: Isaiah 21:4
segments: My heart wavered, fearfulness frightened me; The night for which I longed He turned into fear for me.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:5
segments: Prepare the table, Set a watchman in the tower, Eat and drink. Arise, you princes, Anoint the shield!

entries.title: Isaiah 21:6
segments: For thus has the Lord said to me: "Go, set a watchman, Let him declare what he sees."

entries.title: Isaiah 21:7
segments: And he saw a chariot [with] a pair of horsemen, A chariot of donkeys, [and] a chariot of camels, And he listened earnestly with great care.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:8
segments: Then he cried, "A lion, my Lord! I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime; I have sat at my post every night.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:9
segments: And look, here comes a chariot of men [with] a pair of horsemen!" Then he answered and said, "Babylon is fallen, is fallen! And all the carved images of her gods He has broken to the ground."

entries.title: Isaiah 21:10
segments: Oh, my threshing and the grain of my floor! That which I have heard from the LORD of hosts, The God of Israel, I have declared to you.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:11
segments: ¶The burden against Dumah. He calls to me out of Seir, "Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?"

entries.title: Isaiah 21:12
segments: The watchman said, "The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire; Return! Come back!"

entries.title: Isaiah 21:13
segments: ¶The burden against Arabia. In the forest in Arabia you will lodge, O you traveling companies of Dedanites.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:14
segments: O inhabitants of the land of Tema, Bring water to him who is thirsty; With their bread they met him who fled.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:15
segments: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, From the bent bow, and from the distress of war.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:16
segments: For thus the Lord has said to me: "Within a year, according to the year of a hired man, all the glory of Kedar will fail;

entries.title: Isaiah 21:17
segments: "and the remainder of the number of archers, the mighty men of the people of Kedar, will be diminished; for the LORD God of Israel has spoken [it]."
